Name: Yam to Sweet Potato
Author: AirynS
Description:
Yams are now called sweet potatoes! This is a quick, simple mod that I made for personal preference, since I like sweet potatoes better than yams, and to celebrate harvesting my first sweet potatoes from my little garden.

Changes the name for yams, yam seeds, and glazed yams, including in the Queen of Sauce episode and in Penny's secret note.

Soft-incompatible with Cornucopia, SVE, and any other mods that add sweet potatoes as a new custom crop - nothing will break, but you'll have two varieties of sweet potato. Maybe this is something you actually want? If you do, go nuts & have as many sweet potatoes as you like.

Downloads.Description: To install, just unzip the folder and drop it in your Mods folder.
